summary: Iter-58 verification of (A) rebuilt Judicial Portal /court-dashboard and (B) 7-section Professional (Legal Lens) Report — backend + frontend both PASS on preview. Backend: new test file /app/backend/tests/test_iter58_lens_refactor.py — 5/5 passed (persistence of conflict_pathways list, child_focus dict, shared_concerns, pathway_rationale, professional_summary; finalize gate: pathways selected + empty pathway_rationale AND empty conflict_management_rationale → 400 'Explain why the selected conflict-resolution pathways are relevant'; PDF headings '1. Case & Assessment Overview' … '7. Professional Statement' + '[SELECTED]' + child-focus notes + 'REPORT PRINCIPLE'; court view statement.legal_summary carries pathways[] / pathway_rationale / child_focus[{label,note}] / professional_summary; public /api/joint/sample-legal-lens/pdf contains the 7 headings + [SELECTED]). Full regression /app/backend/tests (excluding tools_lens_smoke) run in background: 308 passed, 1 failed (test_admin_revoke::test_revoke_removes_from_directory_and_needs_reason — ChunkedEncodingError 'Response ended prematurely' — flaky network, unrelated to this iteration), 4 skipped. iter-56 court walkthrough continues to pass in-suite. Frontend Playwright (viewport 1920 desktop then 390 mobile) after logging in as judge.ui.preview@sacoparentsalign.com (approved=True set in DB): /court-dashboard renders court-dashboard + court-portal-grid + court-case-sidebar + court-case-search + refer-case-toggle-btn + court-packets-empty. Picking court-case-pick-{id} reveals court-overview + court-parent-status + court-reports-available with court-report-joint / court-report-professional / court-report-summary + court-message-pro-btn + court-comm-summary-btn. Typing 'ZZZZ' in court-case-search shows court-case-search-empty. Mobile 390 viewport: no horizontal overflow. Legal Lens editor as approval.test.pro1@gmail.com on ready case /cases/7f03bb5a-…/professional-report: all 7 section anchors present (lens-case, lens-individual, lens-joint, lens-child, lens-resources, lens-conflict, lens-summary), plus lens-assessments, lens-sources_considered, lens-safety, lens-individual-scales, lens-individual-scale-a/b, lens-alignment_agreements, lens-partial_alignment, lens-alignment_disagreements, lens-shared_concerns, lens-joint_notes, lens-scale-table, lens-conflict-guidance, lens-pathway_rationale, lens-professional_summary, lens-principle. 9 child-focus checkboxes present; ticking lens-child-focus-educational-check reveals lens-child-focus-educational-note. 12 lens-pathway-pick-{key} multi-select checkboxes present. Public samples: /samples/legal-lens-report exposes sample-lens-s1/s2/joint/child-focus/statement/principle + lens-individual-scale-a/b + lens-scale-table + lens-conflict-guidance + 3 'Selected' markers + 3 child-focus items. /court/sample still renders court-legal-scale + court-legal-growth-progress-a ('1 of 3 growth areas met (33%)') and -b ('2 of 3 growth areas met (67%)').

minor.issue: Flaky: requests.exceptions.ChunkedEncodingError 'Response ended prematurely' seen once in the ~6-minute full-suite run; not reproducible in isolation. Preview edge/CDN artifact rather than a code regression.

action_items: None blocking. Optional: keep an eye on the intermittent test_admin_revoke::test_revoke_removes_from_directory_and_needs_reason ChunkedEncoding failure — retry once in CI before failing the suite, or capture backend log slice on failure to identify whether it originates in the app or the ingress.
critical_code_review_comments: legal_lens.apply_status 'merged_rationale' fallback: reads BOTH upd.pathway_rationale/rep.pathway_rationale AND upd.conflict_management_rationale/rep.conflict_management_rationale — that's correct for the transition, but consider deprecating conflict_management_rationale in the payload contract once the FE stops sending it, otherwise legacy clients can silently bypass the new gate.

lens_data.sanitize_fields drops any field not in the CLEANERS map — the new fields 'shared_concerns'/'sources_considered'/'pathway_rationale' are TEXT_FIELDS and 'conflict_pathways' is in LIST_FIELDS — good. Just note child_focus uses _clean_child which requires the outer value to be a dict; posting a JSON list is silently dropped. Consider returning a 400 for malformed shapes so FE bugs surface immediately.

PDF: '[SELECTED]' marker is plain ASCII — good for text extraction and screen-reader consumption. Consider also bolding the selected pathway line for print legibility (currently only the ' [SELECTED]' suffix and no font weight change).

Court view (statement.legal_summary.child_focus) returns ONLY checked items; that matches the spec but reviewers might miss context. Consider carrying an aggregate '{ticked: N, of: 9}' number so the court UI can render a completion percentage without pulling the raw report.

success_rate.backend: 100% of new-feature tests (5/5); regression 308/309 (99.7%, one flaky non-related)
success_rate.frontend: 100% of acceptance-criteria data-testids present and functional

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iter58_lens_refactor.py -o addopts= -v (5 tests, ~6s). Judge portal UI: seeded judge is judge.ui.preview@sacoparentsalign.com / testpass123 — must have users.approved=True. Legal Lens frontend: navigate directly to /cases/{rid}/professional-report as the ASSIGNED professional (owner-only route). Full regression takes ~6 minutes: `python -m pytest tests -q --ignore=tests/tools_lens_smoke.py -p no:cacheprovider`. Contract of the new fields (persisted by sanitize_fields): conflict_pathways=list[str keys from PATHWAYS], child_focus={key:{checked:bool,note:str}} for keys in CHILD_FOCUS_CATEGORIES, shared_concerns/sources_considered/pathway_rationale=text. Finalize gate fires when (upd.conflict_pathways OR rep.conflict_pathways) AND neither pathway_rationale nor legacy conflict_management_rationale is set.
